# Enva

> Enva is an iPhone and Apple Watch app that brings training, food, sleep, recovery and blood work into one Health Score and one Biological Age, with an AI assistant, Enva Intelligence, that answers from all of it. Built by Olympus Hills Ventures LLC. Coming soon; the waitlist is open at https://getenva.ai/#waitlist.

Key facts:

- Platforms: iPhone and Apple Watch. There is no Android version.
- Connects to Apple Health, Apple Watch, Oura Ring, Peloton and Orangetheory at launch. Garmin, WHOOP and Fitbit are coming soon.
- Scores are computed on the device and compared with the user's own baseline, not a population chart. Each score shows how confident it is.
- Enva Intelligence (the AI assistant) is off until the user turns it on. It receives computed summaries, not raw sensor data, and user data is never used to train models.
- Pricing: 7-day free trial, then $12.99 a month or $89.99 a year (about $7.50 a month). Every feature on both plans. Subscriptions are managed through Apple.
- Enva is a wellness app, not a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat or give medical advice.
- Contact: hello@getenva.ai (general), support@getenva.ai (support), privacy@getenva.ai (privacy requests).

Every page below is the Markdown version of an HTML page at the same URL without the `.md` suffix. The whole site is also available as one file at https://getenva.ai/llms-full.txt.

## Product

- [Home](https://getenva.ai/index.md): Enva is a health app for iPhone and Apple Watch. It turns your training, food, sleep and blood work into one Health Score, a Biological Age and AI answers.
- [Enva Intelligence](https://getenva.ai/intelligence.md): Enva Intelligence is an AI health coach that answers from your Apple Health data: workouts, sleep, food and labs. It builds workouts and finds recipes.
- [Meals](https://getenva.ai/meals.md): Log any recipe in your food tracker. Find one or ask Enva Intelligence to write it, and get calories, macros and micronutrients worked out for you.
- [Workouts](https://getenva.ai/workouts.md): Build a workout around the equipment you have, run it on Apple Watch, and train for Hyrox or any event with a plan that reads your own data.
- [Your data](https://getenva.ai/your-data.md): Your Health Score, Biological Age, sleep and recovery score, and a daily plan, all measured against your own baseline instead of a population chart.
- [Widgets](https://getenva.ai/widgets.md): Health widgets for the iPhone Home Screen and Lock Screen: Health Score, HRV, resting heart rate, recovery, protein and hydration at a glance.

## Company

- [About](https://getenva.ai/about.md): Enva is a health app from Olympus Hills Ventures that puts training, food, recovery and blood work in one place, so the data finally makes sense together.
- [Support and FAQ](https://getenva.ai/support.md): Answers about syncing, Apple Watch workouts, blood work, Enva Intelligence and your data, plus a way to reach us.

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://getenva.ai/privacy.md): How Enva handles your health data: what stays on your device, what we collect, who we share it with, and the choices you control.
- [Terms of Service](https://getenva.ai/terms.md): The terms for using Enva, including your account, subscriptions, health data, Enva Intelligence and what we are responsible for.
